domains.name: Rental Asset Operations
domains.scope: Reconcile rental unit allocation, checkout kits, return observations, usage readings, custody follow-up and turnaround handoffs from supplied records without imposing fees or technical acceptance.

skills.name: rental-serial-allocation-reconciliation
skills.description: Reconcile physical rental unit identities with class-level reservations when duplicate serial assignments or substitution constraints obscure fulfillment readiness.

skills.name: rental-checkout-accessory-completeness
skills.description: Reconcile required rental accessories with the actual checkout kit when base-unit presence does not establish complete fulfillment.

skills.name: rental-return-condition-evidence-comparison
skills.description: Compare checkout and return condition evidence for the same rental asset while separating visible changes from unsupported cause or liability conclusions.

skills.name: rental-usage-meter-reading-reconciliation
skills.description: Reconcile rental meter observations into supported usage intervals when units, resets, replacements or transcription conflicts make subtraction unreliable.

skills.name: rental-overdue-custody-followup
skills.description: Prepare an evidence-based follow-up for an apparently overdue rental when due-date changes, pickup arrangements or unposted returns leave custody uncertain.

skills.name: rental-turnaround-readiness-handoff
skills.description: Reconcile rental turnaround task evidence into a release handoff when physical return, completed work and authorization to reallocate are separate states.
